jobs.description: Job Description The Role In-vehicle connectivity and precise positioning are critical enablers for advanced driver assistance, autonomous driving, and connected vehicle services. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Product Management and Systems Engineering to understand use cases, feature roadmaps, and vehicle integration constraints, and reflect them in GNSS hardware requirements. Lab & Conducted Testing Define and execute conducted RF test plans for GNSS, including: Sensitivity and dynamic range. C/N₀, phase noise, and insertion loss characterization. Jamming and interference susceptibility, including coexistence with other in‑vehicle radios. Experience collaborating with suppliers and purchasing on technical evaluations, design reviews, and roadmap alignment. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to present technical topics to both engineering and non-technical audiences. 쿠팡 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
쿠팡이츠서비스 소개
쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다. 여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.

쿠팡이츠서비스 Business & Operations 부문의 Director II, Program Management 는 Operational Excellence 조직을 리드하며 Delivery Operation 운영 전략 수립 및 실행, Operation 최적화, Supply Chain 관리, 고객 경험 개선 등 쿠팡이츠서비스의 핵심 운영 프로세스를 리드합니다. 데이터 기반의 실행력과 고객 중심의 사고역량을 통해 End-to-End 운영 효율성을 극대화해 고객 만족도를 높이는 데 중점을 둡니다.

jobs.description:
Riot Games is looking for a community management lead to continue building and supporting Riftbound’s global player community.
As the community management lead for Riftbound, you will set the product’s community strategy and lead its execution across launches, product releases, organized play, live events, and evergreen engagement. You will manage and develop a team of community professionals, establish clear operating practices, and ensure player perspectives inform publishing and product decisions.
You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Social, Influencer, PR, Organized Play, Product teams, and partners to deliver coordinated, player-first experiences. You will also partner with regional teams to support locally relevant community strategies and maintain alignment across global programs.
You will report to the Editor-in-Chief, Riftbound Publishing team.
Responsibilities:
Community Strategy
Set and lead Riftbound’s global community strategy in support of product and publishing goals.
Develop programs that strengthen player acquisition, onboarding, engagement, advocacy, and long-term community health.
Ensure community priorities are integrated into product launches, organized play, retail moments, campaigns, and live events.
Establish clear goals, operating plans, and success measures for Riftbound community initiatives.
Identify emerging player needs, community risks, opportunities, and guide the team’s response.
Balance the needs of competitive players, collectors, casual players, hobby communities, and new TCG audiences.
Player Voice and Communications
Serve as the senior community representative for Riftbound in product and publishing planning.
Ensure player sentiment, feedback, and community insights inform product development and business decisions.
Oversee player-facing communications across articles, social content, community channels, event messaging, and product updates.
Establish communication standards that are clear, authentic, culturally aware, and consistent with Riftbound’s voice.
Lead community response and escalation planning for sensitive or fast-moving issues.
Partner with Product, PR, Player Support, and regional teams to deliver coordinated communications.
Community Programs
Oversee community programs across digital platforms, organized play, hobby stores, live events, and creator ecosystems.
Guide the development of community activations that build meaningful relationships between players and Riot.
Partner with Organized Play and Commercial teams to connect digital engagement with retail and in-person play.
Develop scalable programs, toolkits, and guidance that regional teams can adapt for local audiences.
Evaluate program effectiveness using participation, sentiment, engagement, and community-health indicators.
Use performance insights and player feedback to improve future programs.
Cross-Functional and Regional Leadership
Partner with Brand, Creative, Influencer, Social, PR, Events, Organized Play, Product teams, and Partners.
Align stakeholders around community priorities, player needs, messaging, and execution plans.
Support regional community teams with strategic guidance, program frameworks, and escalation management.
Represent Riftbound within Riot’s broader Player Community leadership group.
Manage relationships with agencies, vendors, moderators, and community partners.
Share learnings and best practices that improve community work across Riot.
Required Qualifications:
7+ years of experience in community management, publishing, communications, social media, or a related field.
Experience setting and leading community strategy for a game, entertainment product, consumer brand, or hobby ecosystem.
Experience managing multiple community programs, campaigns, or live-service workstreams.
Strong understanding of player communities, digital platforms, community communications, and engagement practices.
Experience representing player needs to product, marketing, and leadership teams.
Experience managing sensitive community issues and cross-functional escalations.
Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills.
Experience establishing goals, operating processes, and performance measures.
Ability to operate independently and lead through ambiguity.
Desired Qualifications:
Familiarity with Riftbound: the League of Legends trading card game.
Experience with other trading card games, tabletop games, collectibles, organized play, or hobby entertainment.
Knowledge of TCG player communities, retailers, tournament organizers, judges, creators, and collectors.
Experience launching a new game, product, or community ecosystem.
Experience leading community programs across multiple regions.
Familiarity with social listening, sentiment analysis, community-health measurement, and audience insights.
Experience working with physical products, retail partners, or live events.
Personal interest in trading card games and player communities.
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!
Our Perks:
Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our
benefits pages
for more information.
At Riot Games, we
put players first
. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.
It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.
Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:
Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks
Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters
These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

jobs.description: Why Join GEICO? At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities. Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide. Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers. Position Summary GEICO's Pulse team is looking for a Staff Software Engineer who is passionate about building data platforms that give engineering leaders a single source of truth for developer productivity . You will help drive our engineering transformation as we evolve from legacy technology to a living, API-driven insights platform — one that gives developers, managers, and executives meaningful, trustworthy data to make better decisions. This platform is transforming, and you will shape its next chapter. Position Description Our Staff Engineers work across levels to build new systems, improve existing ones, and solve critical problems with data and software. As a technical leader for the Developer Activity Metrics platform, you will define and execute a roadmap that turns raw ADO work item, PR, and AI usage data into clean, reliable, high-value metrics — powering dashboards, alerting, compliance reporting, and continuous improvement conversations across Developer Engineering. You will also help GEICO push the boundary of agentic development by making AI-assisted and agent-driven engineering work measurable, governable, and actionable. Quantifying the impact of these capabilities for technology teams, business leaders, and the broader software delivery organization will ensure that budget is invested in the right place. The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with strong experience in data pipeline engineering, metrics design, and platform thinking . You understand what it takes to keep ETL pipelines healthy, data quality high, and dashboards accurate at enterprise scale — and you know how to make complex engineering metrics legible and useful to the humans relying on them. Position Responsibilities As a Staff Engineer on the Developer Activity Metrics team, you will: Define and drive the overall technical strategy for the Developer Activity Metrics platform, aligning it with GEICO's engineering goals and operating model. Lead data modeling and schema governance for datasets — ensuring metrics are consistently defined, reproducible, and aligned to a common taxonomy across teams. Establish and enforce data quality standards: build reconciliation, drift detection, and validation processes that keep Pulse data accurate and trustworthy over time. Drive the integration strategy between Developer Activity Metrics and adjacent data sources (AI spend, DORA, ADO work items, incident data), ensuring coherent, joined datasets for leadership and team-level reporting. Architect and deliver the API layer, enabling self-service metric consumption by engineering teams, dashboards, and downstream tooling. Partner closely with the other engineering teams, UX/UI, and stakeholder teams to align the metrics platform with how developers and managers work. Build and maintain operational runbooks, monitoring, and alerting so pipelines and dashboards stay healthy with minimal manual intervention. Mentor engineers on the team — coaching on technical design, code quality, and data engineering best practices. Collaborate with executive leadership and engineering managers to communicate the value of accurate developer metrics and foster a culture of data-informed improvement. Qualifications Fluency in modern programming languages — Go, Python. Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred); familiarity I vote for with NoSQL and graph databases a plus. Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT data pipelines at scale, including schema management, backfills, and handling upstream data changes. Experience building data quality, reconciliation, and drift-detection processes that keep metrics accurate over time. Strong API design experience (REST and/or GraphQL), including versioning, schema governance, and building metrics data as a consumable platform service. In-depth knowledge of cloud architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and observability tooling. Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management (Ansible, Terraform). Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical tradeoffs into clear, actionable guidance for engineering managers and executives. Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a bias toward operational excellence and measurable outcomes. Experience 10+ years of professional experience in software engineering. 8+ years of experience with architecture and system design. 6+ years of experience with open-source frameworks. 4+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure. Demonstrated experience building or owning metrics, analytics, or a data platform product at enterprise scale. Experience with developer productivity metrics, engineering analytics, or DORA metrics is strongly preferred. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent education or work experience. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.
